## 👋🏻 Getting Started & Join Our Community We are a group of e/acc design-engineers, hoping to provide modern design components and tools for AIGC. Whether for users or professional developers, LobeHub will be your AI Agent playground. ## ✨ Features
### From new hire to one of the team See what Lobe AI gets done, from its first day in your team chat onward. WHAT MAKES A SUPER-AGENT
🔌 Flexible access
Plug in any IM app, agent or model, all in one place. 		⚡ Parallel work
Runs several tasks at once, so you don't have to chase each one.
🙋 Finds its own work
Takes on the tasks that suit it, without someone passing messages along. 		📈 Gets more expert
The more you use it, the faster an agent builds up its expertise.
### `Day 1` Welcome to the team You add it to your team chat and ask it to read up. By lunch it has gone through the history and said hello to everyone. ![Before it starts, it reads up](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/ed6fc1ef1e21e4add545c1e83c32fcb4.webp) ![Lobe AI's IM Bots settings, its team badge and its Day 1 checklist](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/a1c721a3cbe9cb8ec0f515217322b514.webp)
[![][back-to-top]](#readme-top)
### `Week 1` Its first task Someone posts a feature request in Discord and nobody assigns it. Lobe AI takes it on, and you only step in once, to accept the result. ![Picks it up: nobody tags it, and it takes the request anyway](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/b0c761a9084a5958d4205e5d056fa3ae.webp) ![Hands it in: you check the evidence, accept, and the PR merges](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/b8635a2bf3b600697068d70690a62438.webp) ![Reports back: it replies in the original thread](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/3e187a7e1fd004238163b58e20c59817.webp)
[![][back-to-top]](#readme-top)
### `Month 1–2` Settling in as the team grows Everyone now has their own agent, and design, releases and docs each have a dedicated one. Lobe AI is still learning when to speak up and when to stay quiet. ![One brief every morning](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/c4e5bac0c35f840d9476256996e93e49.webp) ![It's learning when to speak up](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/bc065ed83d1ab0862aea98a7216ff787.webp)
[![][back-to-top]](#readme-top)
### `Month 3` It passes its review When it started, it got about half of these right. Now it rarely misses, and every correction you gave it has become a lesson it keeps. ![What it has learned](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/82c6818a9dc6fa27cf5aea75a092b448.webp)
[![][back-to-top]](#readme-top)

## 🧩 Marketplace Find agents, MCP servers and skills on [lobehub.com][official-site], add them to your workspace, or publish your own. | Market | What you'll find | | :------------------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | [**🤖 Agents**][market-agents] | Ready-to-use agents for writing, Q\&A, images, video, voice and workflows. Add one to your workspace and adapt it. | | [**🔌 MCP Servers**][market-mcp] | MCP servers rated on activity, stability and community feedback, so you can pick ones you can trust. | | [**🧠 Skills**][market-skills] | Agent skills in the open `SKILL.md` format. They also work in Claude Code, Codex CLI and ChatGPT. | | [**🎨 AI / LLM Icons**][market-icons] | A free icon set for major AI brands and models, with SVG, PNG and vector downloads. | **Publish your own** - **Agents**: submit one from its settings in LobeHub. The [Creator Reward Program][creator-program] features a community agent every two weeks. - **MCP servers**: ask your agent to `Read https://lobehub.com/publish-mcp/skill.md and follow the instructions to publish my MCP server to the LobeHub Marketplace`, or use the CLI: ```bash npx -y @lobehub/market-cli login npx -y @lobehub/market-cli plugin submit https://github.com/OWNER/REPOSITORY ``` - **Skills**: submit a GitHub repository from the [Skills marketplace][market-skills].

## 🛳 Self Hosting Run LobeHub on your own infrastructure and keep your data with you. The full guide is in [📘 Build your own LobeHub][docs-self-hosting]. ### `A` Docker Compose (recommended) [![][docker-release-shield]][docker-release-link] [![][docker-size-shield]][docker-size-link] [![][docker-pulls-shield]][docker-pulls-link] Starts LobeHub with PostgreSQL, Redis, RustFS file storage, SearXNG search and the agent gateway. Runs on Linux and macOS, or on Windows through [WSL 2](https://aka.ms/wsl). ```bash mkdir lobehub && cd lobehub bash <(curl -fsSL https://lobe.li/setup.sh) -l en docker compose up -d ``` Then open . Ports, LAN and domain modes, and upgrades are covered in the [📘 Docker Compose guide][docs-docker]. ### `B` One-click deploy Vercel needs a PostgreSQL database, S3-compatible storage and a few secrets before you deploy. The [📘 Vercel guide][docs-vercel] walks through each one.
| Deploy with Vercel | Deploy with Zeabur | Deploy with Sealos | Deploy with RepoCloud | Deploy with Alibaba Cloud | | :-------------------------------------: | :---------------------------------------------------------: | :---------------------------------------------------------: | :---------------------------------------------------------------: | :-----------------------------------------------------------------------: | | [![][deploy-button-image]][deploy-link] | [![][deploy-on-zeabur-button-image]][deploy-on-zeabur-link] | [![][deploy-on-sealos-button-image]][deploy-on-sealos-link] | [![][deploy-on-repocloud-button-image]][deploy-on-repocloud-link] | [![][deploy-on-alibaba-cloud-button-image]][deploy-on-alibaba-cloud-link] |

## ⌨️ Local Development You can use GitHub Codespaces for online development: [![][codespaces-shield]][codespaces-link] Or clone it for local development: ```fish $ git clone https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub.git $ cd lobehub $ pnpm install $ bun run dev # Full-stack (Next.js + Vite SPA) $ bun run dev:spa # SPA frontend only (port 9876) ``` > **Debug Proxy**: After running `dev:spa`, the terminal prints a proxy URL like > `https://app.lobehub.com/_dangerous_local_dev_proxy?debug-host=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A9876`. > Open it to develop locally against the production backend with HMR — a > development convenience, not a place to verify a change. If you would like to learn more details, please feel free to look at our [📘 Development Guide][docs-dev-guide].

## 🔬 Research - **[📊 MCPMark][mcpmark]:** A stress-testing benchmark for MCP. ## 👋🏻 开始使用 & 交流 我们是一群充满热情的设计工程师，希望为 AIGC 提供现代化的设计组件和工具，并以开源的方式分享。 不论普通用户与专业开发者，LobeHub 旨在成为所有人的 AI Agent 实验场。LobeHub 目前正在积极开发中，有任何需求或者问题，欢迎提交 [issues][issues-link] | [![](https://api.producthunt.com/widgets/embed-image/v1/featured.svg?post_id=1065874&theme=light&t=1769347414733)](https://www.producthunt.com/products/lobehub?launch=lobehub-2&embed=true&utm_source=badge-featured&utm_medium=badge&utm_campaign=badge-lobehub) | 我们已在 Product Hunt 上线！我们很高兴将 LobeHub 推向世界。如果您相信人类与 Agent 共同进化的未来，请支持我们的旅程。 | | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | [![][discord-shield-badge]][discord-link] | 加入我们的 Discord 社区！这是你可以与开发者和其他 LobeHub 热衷用户交流的地方 | > \[!IMPORTANT] > > **收藏项目**，你将从 GitHub 上无延迟地接收所有发布通知～⭐️ [![][image-star]][github-stars-link]

## ✨ 特性一览
### 从入职到转正 看看 Lobe AI 进群以后，从第一天到现在都做了些什么。 Super-Agents 有什么不一样
🔌 灵活接入
各类 IM、Agent、模型一站接入 		⚡ 高效并行
多项任务并行处理，无需逐一跟进
🙋 主动找活干
主动承接适合的任务，不再靠人传话 		📈 越干越专业
用得越多，Agent 的专长积累得越快
### `第 1 天` 欢迎入职 你把它拉进群，让它先看看以前的聊天记录。午饭前它就看完了，也跟大家打过了招呼。 ![开工前，先看聊天记录](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/1de871746b650c08b2157660b2bce405.webp) ![Lobe AI 的 IM 机器人设置、工牌和第一天的入职清单](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/a1c721a3cbe9cb8ec0f515217322b514.webp)
[![][back-to-top]](#readme-top)
### `第 1 周` 第一个任务 有人在 Discord 里提了个需求，没人指派，Lobe AI 自己接了。整件事你只在最后验收了一次。 ![接活：没人 @ 它，它自己接下了需求](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/56b3c961db5232bdb490c33a8e5b1ebf.webp) ![交付：你看完证据点了验收，PR 自动合入](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/c408421a48d93a0b22c401baa0118c84.webp) ![汇报：回到原来的讨论串里汇报](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/91e2553b8d7710275f332763188a111f.webp)
[![][back-to-top]](#readme-top)
### `第 1–2 个月` 慢慢上手，团队也在加人 每个人都有了自己的 agent，设计、发版和文档也各有一个专门的 agent。Lobe AI 还在学什么时候该说话，什么时候别打扰。 ![每天早上一份简报](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/029009cccc4eb41aa1afbeeef3f95847.webp) ![它在学什么时候该说话](https://hub-apac-1.lobeobjects.space/blog/assets/e246695af12a50fc3be4a66a017395d5.webp)

## 🧩 市场 在 [lobehub.com][official-site] 上找 Agent、MCP 服务器和技能，添加到你的工作空间，也可以发布你自己的。 | 市场 | 内容 | | :--------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | [**🤖 Agent 助理**][market-agents] | 可直接使用的 AI 助理，覆盖写作、问答、图像、视频、语音与工作流，添加到空间后可以按需调整。 | | [**🔌 MCP 服务器**][market-mcp] | 按活跃度、稳定性与社区反馈筛选 MCP 服务器，帮你找到可信的服务。 | | [**🧠 技能**][market-skills] | 采用开放的 `SKILL.md` 格式，同样可以在 Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 ChatGPT 里使用。 | | [**🎨 AI / LLM 模型图标**][market-icons] | 免费的 AI 品牌与模型图标库，支持下载 SVG、PNG 与矢量文件。 | **发布你自己的** - **Agent**：在 LobeHub 里打开它的设置即可提交。[创作者奖励计划][creator-program]每两周精选一个社区 Agent。 - **MCP 服务器**：让你的 agent 执行 `Read https://lobehub.com/publish-mcp/skill.md and follow the instructions to publish my MCP server to the LobeHub Marketplace`，或者用命令行： ```bash npx -y @lobehub/market-cli login npx -y @lobehub/market-cli plugin submit https://github.com/OWNER/REPOSITORY ``` - **技能**：在[技能市场][market-skills]提交 GitHub 仓库。

## 🛳 开箱即用 在自己的服务器上运行 LobeHub，数据留在你手里。完整教程见 [📘 构建属于自己的 LobeHub][docs-self-hosting]。 ### `A` 使用 Docker Compose 部署（推荐） [![][docker-release-shield]][docker-release-link] [![][docker-size-shield]][docker-size-link] [![][docker-pulls-shield]][docker-pulls-link] 一起启动 LobeHub、PostgreSQL、Redis、RustFS 文件存储、SearXNG 搜索和 Agent Gateway。支持 Linux 和 macOS，Windows 请通过 [WSL 2](https://aka.ms/wsl) 运行。 ```bash mkdir lobehub && cd lobehub bash <(curl -fsSL https://lobe.li/setup.sh) -l zh_CN docker compose up -d ``` 然后打开 。端口、局域网与域名模式，以及升级方法，见 [📘 使用 Docker Compose 部署][docs-docker]。 ### `B` 一键部署 在 Vercel 上部署前，需要准备 PostgreSQL 数据库、S3 兼容存储和几个密钥，[📘 在 Vercel 上部署][docs-vercel] 里有每一项的说明。
| 使用 Vercel 部署 | 使用 Zeabur 部署 | 使用 Sealos 部署 | 使用 RepoCloud 部署 | 使用阿里云计算巢部署 | | :-------------------------------------: | :---------------------------------------------------------: | :---------------------------------------------------------: | :---------------------------------------------------------------: | :-----------------------------------------------------------------------: | | [![][deploy-button-image]][deploy-link] | [![][deploy-on-zeabur-button-image]][deploy-on-zeabur-link] | [![][deploy-on-sealos-button-image]][deploy-on-sealos-link] | [![][deploy-on-repocloud-button-image]][deploy-on-repocloud-link] | [![][deploy-on-alibaba-cloud-button-image]][deploy-on-alibaba-cloud-link] |

## ⌨️ 本地开发 可以使用 GitHub Codespaces 进行在线开发： [![][codespaces-shield]][codespaces-link] 或者使用以下命令进行本地开发： ```fish $ git clone https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub.git $ cd lobehub $ pnpm install $ bun run dev # 全栈开发（Next.js + Vite SPA） $ bun run dev:spa # 仅 SPA 前端（端口 9876） ``` > **Debug Proxy**：运行 `dev:spa` 后，终端会输出代理 URL，如 > `https://app.lobehub.com/_dangerous_local_dev_proxy?debug-host=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A9876`。 > 打开此链接可在线上环境中加载本地开发服务器，支持 HMR 热更新。 如果你希望了解更多详情，欢迎可以查阅我们的 [📘 开发指南][docs-dev-guide]
